text_block_list.text: One day, while walking through the academy...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"Haaah... It's been a while since I've just walked like this.
Fatigue from the races has really been piling up."

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Did the rustling of the leaves sound a bit different?
It's light, and tickles just a little...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
...Today, let's walk while listening to the rustling leaves.
That should help catch my breath, right?

Regretting that I had disrupted her pace,
I considered adjusting her schedule.
